promotionGate: Red authoring may proceed from sealed S0 requirements; Green and release promotion require accepted S4 and S5 receipts

writeLease.canonicalization: UTF-8 JSON; ensure_ascii=false; sort_keys=true; separators=(',',':'); SHA-256

layerContract.L3: connect at least dispatch plus Controller through their production interfaces and the same real temporary SQLite/WAL root; prove serialization identity and both Scheduled/Audit durable observations
layerContract.L4: connect real S1/S2/S3 production components; only model, publisher and notification transports may be deterministic protocol substitutes; assert separate Scheduled/Public/Readiness lineage and terminal hashes
layerContract.L5: connect dispatch, ledger/controller, execution product gate, public and recovery through their public interfaces; assert recovery never overwrites Scheduled and completed children are not replayed
layerContract.L6: invoke the real Python module subprocess in an isolated Japanese path using UTF-8 and a real filesystem restart over WAL/SQLite; fault injection is the only fake and stdout is exactly one RECONCILE_RESULT_V1 JSON object with typed exit mapping
layerContract.L7: bind tracked source bytes, staged installed bytes, structured Task definition, executable, ordered argv and working directory; use STOP_BEFORE_RESERVE only as the external-provider substitute and assert child process no-window contract

releaseEvidenceContract.layerEvidence: exact LAYER_EVIDENCE_V1 rows for L0-L7; each row has layer, realRequired, fakeUsed, schemaIdentity, evidenceSha256 and status=GREEN; fakeUsed must be a subset of the sealed layer manifest and all required real boundaries must be observed
releaseEvidenceContract.l8Admission: exact E2E_FINAL_ADMISSION_V1; accepted S0-S5 receipts plus L0-L7 GREEN hashes, installed source/hash parity, external mutation suppression only, attemptBudget=1, attemptsUsed=0, independent blockerCount=0; missing/unknown/stale/duplicate/second attempt rejects without executing anything
releaseEvidenceContract.history: exact HISTORY_COVERAGE_V1 over 30 Asia/Tokyo dates, explicit missing days, introduction date, timezone, 63+8 corpus counts, Scheduled/Recovery/Public/Readiness separate and legacyWriterCount=0
releaseEvidenceContract.natural: exact NATURAL_OPERATION_EVIDENCE_V1 with installed commit/hash/freshness and four distinct Scheduled, Audit, Public, Readiness receipts; issueDate and generation bound; Public NOT_REQUIRED allowed only as typed terminal while Scheduled/Audit remain GREEN
releaseEvidenceContract.nonSubstitution: L8 receipt cannot satisfy L9, recovery cannot satisfy Scheduled, Public cannot satisfy Readiness, prior date/generation/installed hash cannot satisfy current evidence; unknown extra route/schema/key fails closed

testDesignRules: retain exactly the six top-level names; matrices and mutations stay inside them
use production interfaces and real temp SQLite/WAL/filesystem/subprocess for required boundaries; no monkeypatch of production validators or storage
protocol substitutes are allowed only for the exact fakeSubstitution list sealed in S0 and must expose public call/query observations
use a Japanese-named isolated temp root, aware Asia/Tokyo times, UTF-8, shell=false and CREATE_NO_WINDOW for the real subprocess
assert structured stdout/exit/state/receipt/hash values, not source-text presence or mock call prose
include positive, unknown-key, missing-key, hash-drift, cross-date, cross-generation, replay and mutation-kill cases for every evidence validator
tests must never touch Task Scheduler, UAC, network, public services, user windows, credentials or paths outside pytest temp roots
do not execute L8 or claim L9; only test fail-closed admission and evidence validators
every node dynamically imports the missing release validator before any expensive setup so baseline Expected Red is six causal ModuleNotFoundError failures

verification.redExpected: exactly six failures caused by absent tools.news_grasp_cleanroom_release; collection errors zero

commitPolicy.message: test: define S6 release evidence boundaries

causalRetryCondition: one authoring attempt and one ordered verification chain; return at the first design/static mismatch without production edits
delivery: two test-owned files, hashes/bytes, exact six-Red evidence, per-layer real/fake coverage and zero external mutation
